$Comment: The Great Turkey's fight in the Turkey Graveyard, a Variant of this pack's Orbis_Boss_Encounter_Template
(its comment tells the whole flow). It runs in Prefabs/Harvest_Feast/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard.prefab.json,
the Headless Horseman's graveyard again, so its reach is his: the distances below are his normal
fight's, measured the same way (that file tells them).
The waves before it rises are GuardWave, ziggfreed-common's Zc_Wave_Chain, set in _ForwardedModifiers
below, the way the Horseman's hard ride raises its skeletons. As players arrive (8 seconds on, once the
intro camera is done), the first wave of Turkey Souls rises: three on the plaza south of the fountain,
7 blocks north of the fight's entity across 90 degrees, and two at the fountain's north corners, 19
blocks out across 37 degrees, and every member is told (Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Souls_Rise, with the
wave's number). Once the last of a wave falls, the next rises 4 seconds later; a wave none of which is
seen within 3 seconds counts as beaten, so a spot that fails never holds the fight. Its Done flag,
Orbis_Boss_Waves_Done, is one the template never clears, so once the waves are beaten they stay beaten
after a wipe on the Great Turkey, and it rises again as players come back to the fountain.
Then the Great Turkey rises from Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Marker when players come near, with one
health step per player beyond the first. Phase 1 is its own pecking. At half its health, phase 2
(Macro_Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Rally): it gobbles, three more Turkey Souls rise around the fight's
entity, the music moves on and the members are told (Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Flock). At a fifth,
phase 3, the same macro with its fury: Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Fury goes on it (harder pecks, more
speed, a red glow), two more souls rise, the music turns to its last movement and the members are
told (the moment of the same name). Through every phase more souls rise as its health falls
(FightWaves, the pack's Macro_Orbis_Boss_Fight_Waves): three at a time on the plaza the first time it
falls to 75%, 35% and 10% of its maximum (the fourth step's range of [0, 0] never fires), each telling
the members (Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Souls). A health pack drops now and then on the points the
graveyard's prefab tags Orbis_Boss_Health_Pack, every 80 to 180 seconds. A wipe or a reset clears the
souls and the Great Turkey, and Macro_Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Reset clears the phases' flags.
Its death pays each credited player Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Daily (the first win each day) and
Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Chase (the Boss Kill Claim, every win), both under Server/Rewards/Harvest_Feast;
the dungeon pays its clear beside them (ZiggfreedCommon/Dungeons/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard.json).
The binding row ZiggfreedCommon/Encounters/Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Encounter.json names the fight and
keeps its records. Tune a phase in _ForwardedModifiers below (each transition's HealthRange, each
Rally's AddCount), the waves in GuardWave and FightWaves, the health packs in HealthPackInterval. This
file's name is not a role's: a script named after a role replaces it.
